name: STONE
description: As deepfake generation technology rapidly shifts from GAN-centered approaches to text-conditioned image editing models, the demographic attribute distribution imbalance in existing training data has emerged as a critical issue leading to biased generalization in detectors. This paper proposes STONE (Semantic Transformation-Oriented Neural Editing Dataset), constructed from celebrity face images in Celeb-DF under 20 attribute conditions, comprising 19 editing conditions and one original condition, and three image editing models (InstructPix2Pix, Qwen-Image-Edit, and Emu3.5-Image). STONE is designed for data augmentation to reinforce underrepresented or skewed attribute conditions, and provides an experimental setup that enables separate evaluation of detector identity overfitting and generative model dependency through person-ID-level splits and a cross-model evaluation protocol. Experimental results show that STONE-based augmentation achieved AUC improvements of more than 10 percentage points over the baseline across all three evaluation datasets under both random augmentation (Random Aug) and vulnerability-targeted augmentation (Attr Aug).
